stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus is a residential single-family test house (unoccupied twin house O5, Holzkirchen); no industrial or organisational component. The paper identifies a grey-box building thermal (RC) network model for building-physics characterisation via a sequential Monte Carlo method, not an EnPI/EnB energy-performance measurement model in the ISO 50001/50006 sense. Registered 'residential buildings without industrial component' exclusion applies.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper provides a method based on sequential Monte Carlo for estimating states and parameters
